turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you pay $200 by Friday?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Not 200. I can do 120 on Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, $120 on Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, may I speak with the account holder?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: This is his brother. He's not here and I'm not paying his bills.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. I can't discuss the account with you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to make a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll make a payment of $90.00 on Saturday the 7th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $90.00 on November 7.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you pay something this week?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Maybe I can pay $50 Friday, I don't know yet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, let us know when you're sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your past-due amount is $120.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay sixty dollars next Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, sixty dollars next Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would $125 on November 18 work for you?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Deal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $125 on November 18.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When can you make a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $200 on payday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When is your payday?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: It moves around, depends on the shift schedule.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you make a payment early next month?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can pay 260 on the 5th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $260 on the 5th.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay 100 Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The smallest payment we can schedule is $150. Could you do $150?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Fine, 150 Friday then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $150 this Friday.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: My birthday is March 14, 1988, ZIP 99901.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you're verified. Your balance is $530.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: OK thanks, I just wanted to know the number. Bye.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you make a payment toward the $170.00 past due?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $85 tonight after work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $85 today.
